$comment: Every string the player reads. Ids are stable and describe what the text is for; {name} marks a value filled in by the game. To translate, copy this file and keep the ids.
stat.strength.name: Strength
stat.strength.description: Raw physical power. Each point sharpens your sword and your arrows.
stat.dexterity.name: Dexterity
stat.dexterity.description: Agility and reflexes. Each point turns aside more of the damage you take.
stat.constitution.name: Constitution
stat.constitution.description: Toughness and stamina. Each point lets you sprint for longer.
stat.intelligence.name: Intelligence
stat.intelligence.description: Reasoning and arcane skill. Each point adds 2 damage to your spells.
stat.wisdom.name: Wisdom
stat.wisdom.description: Awareness and insight. It has no effect yet.
stat.charisma.name: Charisma
stat.charisma.description: Force of personality. Each point makes enemies drop 5% more coins.
